text_block_list.text:
After returning to the academy from an 
outing with Symboli Rudolf—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun. If you don't mind, could you 
spare me a little more time after this?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I haven't quite had my fill 
of talking with you yet. How about a cup 
of tea?
choice_data_list: Shall we head to the trainer's office?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Thank you. Now then—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Aaaah! Prez, I finally found you!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I've been looking all over for you so we 
could chat! You know, about how I won 
yesterday's race and all that!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Well, well, what do we have here...

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: —President! President Rudolf!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I apologize for disturbing you right after 
your return, but from the Chairwoman to 
the Student Council--

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hold on! We've got a bit of an issue with 
the dorms. Let me talk to you about that 
first!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I will handle the dorm matters later. 
First, we must deal with this urgent 
issue—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you two~! I talked to the President 
first, you know?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You just want attention, don't you?! I'm 
in a hurry here, save it for later!

Suddenly, an uproar concerning Symboli 
Rudolf broke out...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hmm, what should I do...
choice_data_list: Let's save tea for next time.

I wonder if there's anything I can help 
with?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hmm, what should I do...
choice_data_list: Let's save tea for next time.

I wonder if there's anything I can help 
with?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Heh. Can't be helped now that it's come to 
this. Besides—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Our time together isn't limited to just 
today, after all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Everyone! Calm down first. I'll listen to 
you one by one, so let's move somewhere 
else for now.

Once Symboli Rudolf announced that, 
everyone answered obediently, and the room 
settled down...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Well then, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —See you again tomorrow.

Seeing Symboli Rudolf walking ahead, 
leading everyone, I could truly feel how 
deeply respected and trusted she was.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
No, it is not a problem. Something of this 
level is everyday fare. Besides—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Our time together isn't limited to just 
today. Let's save tea for another time.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Everyone! Calm down first. I'll listen to 
you one by one, so let's move somewhere 
else for now.

Once Symboli Rudolf announced that, 
everyone answered obediently, and the room 
settled down...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Well then, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —See you again tomorrow.

Seeing her unite everyone in a single 
instant truly showcased her work as the 
"Emperor."
